Licensing FAQs

What is the difference between Silver and Gold?

TallyPrime Silver supports one user at a time on one computer. TallyPrime Gold supports unlimited concurrent users on a local area network (LAN) or via cloud hosting. Most growing businesses choose Gold.

What is Tally Software Services (TSS)?

TSS is an annual subscription that keeps your TallyPrime up to date — including all version upgrades, KRA compliance updates, and access to Tally's support portal. Without an active TSS, your software still works but you won't receive updates.

Can I upgrade from Silver to Gold later?

Yes. You can upgrade from Silver to Gold at any time by paying the difference. Your data and configurations are fully preserved.

Is this a genuine TallyPrime licence?

Yes. Optimum Prime Solutions is an authorised TallyPrime partner in Kenya. Every licence we sell is genuine, registered with Tally Solutions, and comes with full local support.
